tasks.title: Let Arrow shift skip the imaginary-time check
tasks.brief: Add a check_imaginary keyword argument to Arrow's shift() method. It must default to True for compatibility, and when False it must skip the DST imaginary-time correction and return the raw shifted result.

tasks.title: Add Arrow's strict RFC 3339 format
tasks.brief: Add a FORMAT_RFC3339_STRICT constant using a T separator while leaving FORMAT_RFC3339 unchanged. It must work with Arrow format().

tasks.title: Migrate Arrow timezone handling to zoneinfo
tasks.brief: Use standard-library zoneinfo behavior for UTC, local, and named IANA zones while preserving ordinary parsing and formatting. A DST-gap wall time must use the offset immediately before the transition.

tasks.title: Pass week_start through Arrow floor and ceil
tasks.brief: Make floor() and ceil() accept week_start and the other span keyword arguments, passing them through without changing existing defaults.

tasks.title: Fix Arrow calendar-month humanization
tasks.brief: Make humanize() count fully elapsed calendar months and years using date arithmetic instead of only subtracting month numbers. Short-month boundaries must not be overcounted.

tasks.title: Keep short Arrow differences in weeks
tasks.brief: After calendar-aware month handling, do not describe a 15 or 16 day difference within the same calendar month as a full month. Genuine calendar-month differences must remain month-based.

tasks.title: Speed up uniqueItems for complex arrays
tasks.brief: Improve uniqueItems validation for unsortable arrays such as arrays of objects without changing edge-case equality semantics for NaN, booleans, integers, or nested values.

tasks.title: Defer jsonschema urllib imports
tasks.brief: Do not import urllib.request during ordinary jsonschema import. Import it only on the remote-reference path, preserving that path's behavior.

tasks.title: Accept single-label hostnames
tasks.brief: Allow valid single-label hostnames such as localhost while continuing to reject malformed hostname strings.

tasks.title: Escape unusual JSON error-path properties
tasks.brief: Render empty and unusual property names unambiguously in validation error paths, using quoted bracket notation when needed while preserving ordinary names.

tasks.title: Avoid double-reporting evaluated properties
tasks.brief: When a property is covered by properties but fails its own subschema, do not also report it as unevaluated. Truly unknown properties must still be reported.

tasks.title: Evaluate additional-property subschemas correctly
tasks.brief: When additionalProperties or unevaluatedProperties is a subschema, validate remaining properties against it when calculating which properties were evaluated.

tasks.title: Make TinyDB missing-ID handling consistent
tasks.brief: Update and remove should silently skip missing document IDs and return only IDs that were actually changed, including mixed existing and missing ID requests.

tasks.title: Fix TinyDB LRU value replacement
tasks.brief: When LRUCache.set() receives an existing key, replace the stored value as well as updating recency.

tasks.title: Handle falsy TinyDB cache values
tasks.brief: Detect existing LRU cache keys by membership rather than value truthiness so 0, False, and empty strings retain correct replacement and eviction behavior.

tasks.title: Respect custom TinyDB document classes
tasks.brief: Use the table's configured document_class consistently when detecting explicit document IDs during insert and upsert.

tasks.title: Allow TinyDB to persist empty tables
tasks.brief: Add a persist_empty option that writes a table to storage immediately while preserving lazy behavior for normal tables.

tasks.title: Make TinyDB remove prefer doc_ids
tasks.brief: When remove() receives both cond and doc_ids, honor the explicit doc_ids just as get, contains, and update do.

tasks.title: Compare TinyDB fields by value
tasks.brief: Make field-to-field TinyDB query comparisons compare the actual values, including missing fields and nested paths.

tasks.title: Prevent TinyDB mutable reference leaks
tasks.brief: Ensure TinyDB does not retain live caller-owned nested values and does not return live references to stored mutable data.
